caption: AI outputs can mislead if you skip verification. This carousel provides five concrete prompts to verify AI-generated work and guide decisions. Use it as a quick QA checklist on any report or draft. Do you verify AI outputs before acting? #AIforBusiness #Productivity #AIQA #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: Mistake: AI reports mislead
slides.body: Problem: AI outputs can mislead; verify before decisions. Five prompts to guarantee accuracy.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose accuracy
slides.body: Task: In {OUTPUT}, find factual claims. Output: JSON array of {claim, source, credibility:1-5}.

slides.title: 2. Improve checks
slides.body: Task: For each claim in {OUTPUT}, cross-check with at least 2 sources; Output: JSON array of {claim, source, status: verified/unverified}.

slides.title: 3. Apply decisions
slides.body: Task: Summarize recommended actions from verified claims; Output: JSON array of actions with recommended option.

slides.title: 4. Check bias
slides.body: Task: Detect bias in {OUTPUT} and list at least three blind spots with impact and mitigations.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Task: Generate a 1-page QA checklist for future AI outputs; include checks for accuracy, sourcing, bias, and usefulness.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Thorough checks beat quick AI drafts. Save this workflow and follow @naelbuildingbig for practical prompts.
